fullPassage: Vera couldn't wait for her car to get fixed, but that was going to require longer than initially expected. Unfortunately, that meant relying on the bus for her commute. To add to the cruel irony, it hadn't stopped raining for the past three days. It was already past 7 PM when she stepped off the bus, cold and soaked to the bone, having left her umbrella at the gym. Her place was just one block down the street, but it felt like ten miles in this weather. Her legs moved on their own, and suddenly, the Cups & Blossoms' bell was ringing above her head. The warm, floral scent wrapped around her like a blanket, but it was another kind of welcome that surprised her — a smile from the café owner, soft and unassuming. She was also polite enough not to ask why Vera looked so tired, which was appreciated. Vera now seemed to realize what she had truly needed. Just a friendly face to ease the weight she carried.

that meant relying on the bus for her <u>commute</u>

det.korean: 통근(commute) = 직장 오가기(daily travel to work).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ daily travel to work: 통근, commute 동의
❌ ① vacation: 휴가
❌ ② shopping: 쇼핑
❌ ④ exercise: 운동
det.tip: commute = daily travel to work: 통근, 출퇴근

questions.passage: Vera couldn't wait for her car to get fixed, but that was going to require longer than initially expected. Unfortunately, that meant relying on the bus for her commute. To add to the cruel irony, it hadn't stopped raining for the past three days. It was already past 7 PM when she stepped off the bus, cold and soaked to the bone, having left her umbrella at the gym. Her place was just one block down the street, but it felt like ten miles in this weather. Her legs moved on their own, and suddenly, the Cups & Blossoms' bell was ringing above her head. The warm, floral scent wrapped around her like a blanket, but it was another kind of welcome that surprised her — a smile from the café owner, soft and unassuming. She was also polite enough not to ask why Vera looked so tired, which was appreciated. Vera now seemed to realize what she had truly needed. Just a friendly face to ease the weight she carried.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>appreciated</u>와 의미가 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① resented: 분개한, appreciated 반의어
❌ ② valued: 소중히 여긴, 유사어
❌ ③ welcomed: 환영받은, 유사어
❌ ④ treasured: 소중히 여긴, 유사어
det.tip: appreciated(감사한) = valued = treasured ↔ resented(분개한)
